note: Illustrative graph, not a dispatch record. Model classes must be resolved by the live harness.

tasks.acceptance: Selected interface and observable acceptance are explicit.

estimate_minutes.basis: Read both consumer boundaries, select one interface and write its acceptance criteria.
estimate_minutes.uncertainty: An inconsistent existing consumer may need one additional interface trace.

tasks.acceptance: Backend contract tests and changed behavior pass.

estimate_minutes.basis: Implement one bounded backend behavior and run its contract checks.
estimate_minutes.uncertainty: A failed contract check may require one local repair and rerun.

tasks.acceptance: Frontend handles success, pending and failed operations.

estimate_minutes.basis: Wire the agreed interface into the three visible operation states and verify them.
estimate_minutes.uncertainty: An existing state transition may need correction before verification passes.

tasks.acceptance: Combined user path is verified across both lanes.

estimate_minutes.basis: Run the combined consumer path after both implementation lanes are accepted.
estimate_minutes.uncertainty: One integration mismatch may require a repair and replay.

tasks.acceptance: Independent technical evidence supports the coherent change.

estimate_minutes.basis: Review the bounded coherent diff and its integration evidence independently.
estimate_minutes.uncertainty: One disputed finding may need a focused evidence check.

tasks.acceptance: A fresh user attempt on the real surface achieves the changed goal.

estimate_minutes.basis: A fresh Tester opens the real surface, attempts the goal and verifies resulting state.
estimate_minutes.uncertainty: A recoverable tool problem may require evidence capture and one retry; a product defect triggers re-estimation.
